::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/countries/{code}/postal-codes/{postal}"}
#docs
Answers 404 when the code is unknown.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `string` | **yes** | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive |
| `postal` | `string` | **yes** | The postal code. Spaces and hyphens do not matter. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `postal_code`. One of `postal_code`. |
| `country` | `string` | The country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 code). |
| `postal_code` | `string` | The postal code. |
| `state_code` | `string` | Our subdivision code (the `state_code` an address stores), or null if none matched. |
| `state_name` | `string` | The postal code lookup's state name. |
| `cities` | `array of string` | The distinct place names for the code. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | Unknown postal code |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/countries/US/postal-codes/Postal"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "postal_code",
  "country": "IN",
  "postal_code": "600001",
  "state_code": "TN",
  "state_name": "Tamil Nadu",
  "cities": [
    "Chennai"
  ]
}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "Unknown postal code"
  }
}
```
:::
::
